question: What runs at cp-00, and how do the two Workers talk?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph web["apps/web · Worker · TanStack Start"]
    WR["routes · /login · /healthz"]
    WA["lib/api.ts · env.API"]
  end
  subgraph api["apps/api · Worker · Hono"]
    H["Hono · /healthz · /readyz · /plans/:planId"]
    DO[("PlanRoom DO · SQLite event log")]
    D1[("D1 · flags")]
  end
  subgraph dom["packages/domain"]
    DEC["thread decider · route · project"]
  end
  subgraph sch["packages/schema"]
    S["Id · Decision · Thread · PlanView"]
  end
  WR --> WA
  WA -- "service binding · fetch" --> H
  H -- "RPC · dispatch(command, flags)" --> DO
  H -- "SQL · SELECT flags" --> D1
  DO -- "import · route, project" --> DEC
  DEC -- "import · zod types" --> S
  WR -- "workspace dependency" --> S

steps.caption: The web Worker is TanStack Start and serves /login and /healthz.
The api Worker is Hono and answers health, readiness and plan commands.
One PlanRoom Durable Object per plan keeps the event log in its own SQLite.
D1 holds the flags table, read once per request and passed on as names.
packages/domain holds the Thread decider, and the Durable Object routes every command through it.
packages/schema is the vocabulary as zod types, and both sides depend on it.
The web Worker reaches data only through the service binding to the api.
